# Harness Kit

> Open-source harness-engineering toolkit for building software with AI coding
> agents: multi-agent orchestration CLI (odin), task board with proof-of-work
> (taskit), and Pattern Engineering — reusable engineering patterns (TDD-first
> execution, structured RCA, knowledge compounding, cost-aware delegation)
> that adopt into any repo.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what the kit is, quickstarts, FAQ
- [Pattern Engineering Quickstart](docs/Quickstart.md): agent-first adoption
  flow — audit a repo, score it, adopt approved practices
- [Run the kit](QUICKSTART.md): fresh clone to a merged sample task
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): entrypoint for coding agents working in this repo
